cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this hands-on tutorial, the last of our container series, which will be this time on Amazon EKS, Elastic Kubernetes Service.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到容器系列最後實作，Amazon EKS，Elastic Kubernetes Service。

cues.en: So first thing's first, as a quick reminder, EKS is a managed Kubernetes designed service used to deploy scale and manage machinery model containers
cues.zh: 快速提醒，EKS 是受管 Kubernetes 服務，部署、擴展、管理模型容器，

cues.en: with maximum flexibility and control.
cues.zh: 提供最大彈性與控制。

cues.en: And as usual, I'll remind the workflow, the usual workflow, here are the steps.
cues.zh: 照慣例回顧一般流程。

cues.en: First, just like with ECS, you store your image in ECR by pushing your models darker image including the inference code to Amazon ECR.
cues.zh: 和 ECS 一樣，先把含推論程式的模型 Docker 映像，推送到 ECR。

cues.en: Then in step two, you create what we call an EKS cluster, which is the Kubernetes environment that is managed by AWS and where your containerized applications,
cues.zh: 第二步建 EKS 叢集，也就是 AWS 管理的 Kubernetes 環境，容器化應用，

cues.en: which are your machinery models run, and that's exactly what we'll do in this demo.
cues.zh: 也就是模型在這裡執行，這正是本堂示範。

cues.en: We will create this EKS cluster that will be the managed Kubernetes setup that will provide the infrastructure to deploy, run, and scale your containers on AWS.
cues.zh: 建立 EKS 叢集，提供在 AWS 部署、執行、擴展容器的受管基礎設施。

cues.en: And then in step three, you finally deploy to your EKS cluster.
cues.zh: 第三步部署到 EKS 叢集。

cues.en: All right, so here we go, let's start the demo of Elastic Kubernetes Service.
cues.zh: 開始 EKS 示範。

cues.en: Elastic Kubernetes Service, here it is, the most trusted way to start, run and scale Kubernetes.
cues.zh: Elastic Kubernetes Service，就在這裡，啟動、執行、擴展 Kubernetes 的可靠方式。

cues.en: Here we go, let's enter the service, and welcome to Elastic Kubernetes Service, Amazon EKS.
cues.zh: 進服務，歡迎來到 Amazon EKS。

cues.en: Oh, let's go back to the welcome page.
cues.zh: 先回歡迎頁。

cues.en: A fully managed Kubernetes cluster infrastructure.
cues.zh: 全受管 Kubernetes 叢集基礎設施。

cues.en: Amazon EKS is a managed service that makes it easy for you to use Kubernetes on AWS without needing to install and operate your own Kubernetes infrastructure, therefore, fully managed.
cues.zh: 不用自行安裝、操作 Kubernetes 基礎設施，就能在 AWS 使用，因此全受管。

cues.en: All right, so here we go, let's create a cluster.
cues.zh: 建立叢集。

cues.en: But first, know that you can either create it or register it.
cues.zh: 先知道，可以建立或註冊。

cues.en: And, of course, for this demo, we'll just create it, okay?
cues.zh: 這次示範建立。

cues.en: So first, you have the choice between two configurations.
cues.zh: 先有兩種設定。

cues.en: The easy one, which is the quick configuration where you don't have much to configure or the custom one where you have, of course, more options to configure, okay?
cues.zh: Quick configuration 很簡單，沒太多要設；Custom 則更多選項。

cues.en: So the custom configuration is actually a bit advanced and out of the scope for the exam, so we'll go with the quick configuration, but you'll still see the essential configuration that you can do on your cluster.
cues.zh: Custom 較進階、超過考試範圍，所以用 Quick，但仍看基本設定。

cues.en: First, we have to give it a name, and we get this suggested name, which each time is different when you try to create a new cluster, but we'll go for machine learning cluster.
cues.zh: 先命名，建議名稱每次不同，但這裡用 machine-learning-cluster。

cues.en: Then you have to choose a Kubernetes version.
cues.zh: 選 Kubernetes 版本。

cues.en: Here, that's probably the latest one at the time I'm speaking, 1.33.
cues.zh: 我錄影時可能最新是 1.33。

cues.en: Ah, no, there is actually 1.34.
So actually let's go with the suggested one, 1.33.
cues.zh: 還是選建議的 1.33。

cues.en: Then here you have to select a cluster IAM role, and since we don't have any role, well, we actually do have to create a new one, but since I'm not gonna end up creating that cluster,
cues.zh: 選 Cluster IAM role，目前沒有，所以要建，但這次最後不會真的建立叢集，

cues.en: we won't create that IAM role in the IAM console because that's a whole different tutorial.
cues.zh: 所以不去 IAM 建角色，那是另一堂內容。

cues.en: So I'm gonna close this and just remember that, of course, in order to allow the Kubernetes control plane to manage AWS resources on your behalf, you have to select an IAM role, okay?
cues.zh: 關閉，只記得要讓 Kubernetes 控制平面代表你管理 AWS 資源，就需選角色。

cues.en: You also have to select a node IAM role.
cues.zh: 也要 Node IAM role。

cues.en: And same for this, you will need to create a recommended role outside of Kubernetes in IAM.
cues.zh: 同樣到 Kubernetes 之外的 IAM，建立建議角色。

cues.en: Then you can use the default VPC in the quick setup, and actually in the custom setup, you can actually configure another VPC.
cues.zh: Quick 用預設 VPC，Custom 可選另一個。

cues.en: And then there you go, you have this subnet of the VPC automatically selected here.
cues.zh: 這裡自動選了 VPC 子網路。

cues.en: And we can even have a look at the quick configuration default, because that's interesting.
cues.zh: 也看看 Quick configuration defaults，很有意思。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: We have no cluster IAM role, but we would need one if we create that cluster all the way, and you would create an IAM role.
cues.zh: 尚無 Cluster IAM role，真要建立就需先去 IAM 建。

cues.en: We have enabled the EKS auto mode.
cues.zh: EKS Auto Mode 已啟用。

cues.en: Same we need a node IAM role, which we would create in IAM.
cues.zh: Node IAM role 同樣要到 IAM 建。

cues.en: We are using by default the general purpose node pools, then we have cluster administrator access, and the cluster authentication mode is on the EKS API.
cues.zh: 預設用 General purpose node pools，有叢集管理員存取，驗證模式是 EKS API。

cues.en: Deletion production is deactivated.
cues.zh: Deletion protection 未啟用。

cues.en: We have an encryption done by AWS with the AWS owned key.
cues.zh: 用 AWS 擁有的金鑰加密。

cues.en: Upgrade policies, standard support, and the rest is not really important.
cues.zh: Upgrade policies 為 Standard support，其餘不重要。

cues.en: These are the networking details related, of course, to the VPC and subnet.
cues.zh: 這是 VPC、子網路等網路細節。

cues.en: And we have some cluster logging for observability in case of audit requirements, okay?
cues.zh: 也有叢集日誌，供可觀測性與稽核。

cues.en: So there we go, that's how you would create your EKS cluster.
cues.zh: 這就是建立 EKS 叢集的方法。

cues.en: Of course, now, I'm gonna cancel it because we don't have the IAM roles, but this is how you would create quickly and efficiently your EKS cluster.
cues.zh: 當然現在取消，因為沒有 IAM 角色，但這是快速有效率的建立方式。

cues.en: All right, so that's it.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: We'll end up our container journey here for machinery model deployment, and this was also the last hands-on tutorial of this section because we already did the cleanup
cues.zh: 模型部署的容器旅程到此，也是本節最後實作，因為先前已經清理

cues.en: of all the SageMaker resources previously in this section.
cues.zh: 全部 SageMaker 資源。

cues.en: Please make sure to do it if you haven't done it already, that's super important.
cues.zh: 還沒做務必做，很重要。

cues.en: And so now, look forward to seeing you in the next section on machine learning workflow automation with CI/CD pipelines.
cues.zh: 下一節見，使用 CI/CD 管線自動化機器學習工作流程。

cues.en: So I'll look forward to seeing you there, and until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 期待見到你，在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
